training_protocol.name: same_season_walk_forward
training_protocol.rule: For target season Y and round R, model variants receive train_seasons=[Y]; rqp.data.build_training_data excludes rounds >= R in the same season.
training_protocol.race_information_cutoff: post-qualifying/pre-race; current-round grid or qualifying fallback is allowed, target race result is not.
training_protocol.qualifying_information_cutoff: post-practice/pre-qualifying; current-round practice features are allowed, target qualifying result is not.
